common_intent_requirements.text: 把一个软木塞按到水面下再松手
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一个软木塞按到水面下再松手
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: A hand presses a cork beneath the water surface and briefly holds it there. The fingers release the cork and withdraw, leaving its upward path unobstructed.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍清它自己浮回水面的过程
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍清它自己浮回水面的过程
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Keep the cork readable from the underwater release through its arrival at the surface.
The final view holds on the cork floating freely, with no hand, thread or other object supporting it.

physics_checks.criterion: 完整软木塞释放后整体上浮，最终停留在水面附近自由漂浮。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 能看见手离开、水下上升和接触水面后的漂浮状态。
fail_examples: 软木塞无额外约束却沉底并长期停住
手离开后软木塞瞬移到水面
软木塞在水面之上无支撑悬浮
not_required: 允许短暂下冲、旋转和上浮后的上下晃动
不要求特定漂浮朝向或精确露出比例

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
